# VDJ-AQP review

Follow AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md. Focus on correctness and minimal changes.
Trace callers and preserve the documented table schemas and scientific defaults.
Check I/L equivalence, half-open reference coordinates, missingness, background
membership, bounded residue evidence and identity ambiguity. Gapped placements
are search-only until per-column scoring geometry exists.

Use synthetic tests; do not request or run private scientific datasets. Verify
resource allocation before numerical imports, process-tree cleanup and manifest
publication safety. Keep private data, source identities, credentials and host
configuration out of commits. Prefer existing APIs and native batch operations.
